# Palm & Tide

> Palm & Tide is a boutique travel curator based in Diani, Kenya, designing complete coastal journeys — accommodation, style, ocean excursions and cultural connection — planned before guests arrive.

## About
Palm & Tide curates trusted local stays, ocean excursions, coastal fashion and cultural connections along Kenya's Swahili Coast in Diani. Each journey is built from four "tides": Stay by the Tide (accommodation), Find Your Style (coastal fashion & accessories), Follow the Tide (ocean excursions), and Meet the Coast (village & cultural connection).

Contact: WhatsApp +254 700 009 988 · Email hello.palmtides@gmail.com · TikTok @palmtideexperience

## Packages
Prices are indicative, converted to USD from KES at the prevailing exchange rate. Kenya's standard 16% VAT and a typical 3% currency conversion fee may apply — confirmed in a personalised quotation.
- The 3-Day Diani Escape — 3 days / 2 nights — from $86 to $340. A short coastal getaway, ideal for long weekends. Includes the Sunset Mangrove Escape excursion.
- The 5-Day Diani Adventure — 5 days / 4 nights — from $172 to $680. Our signature, most-booked package: a curated stay, local styling, a dolphin and snorkelling excursion, a village e-bike tour, and a surprise experience courtesy of Palm & Tide. Full itinerary: https://palmandtideexperience.com/things-to-do-in-diani.html#signature-journey
- The 7-Day Diani Immersion — 7 days / 6 nights — from $258 to $1,020. A slower-paced week along the coast. Includes the Kisite Dolphin Escape excursion.
- Family Journeys — flexible duration — from $43/night. Planned around children and parents together, not just extra beds. Includes the Family Wildlife Adventure excursion.
- Team Building — flexible duration — from $43/night. Group retreats built for teams, not tourists. Includes A Tide-Led Coastal Escape excursion.
- Romantic Escape — 2 days — Standard $325 or Premium $468 for 2 guests. Private glass-bottom boat ride, cave dinner, African Pool and a sunset canoe through the mangroves; Premium adds a night at a beachfront stay.

All six packages, with full details, pricing and an accommodation preference form: https://palmandtideexperience.com/things-to-do-in-diani.html
